# ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry Daily Update (May 19, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
The day saw significant progress in addressing critical bugs related to brotli channel divergence and RPC namespace migration. Several new pull requests were opened, focusing on chain upgrades and CI improvements. Active discussions continued on interop proofs, devnet spin-up, and flaky tests.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

- **Automated Code Generation Update**: An automated code generation update was merged, specifically modifying the `addresses.json` file within the `superchain/extra` directory. ([#1236](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1236))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- **Chain Upgrades and Timestamps**: Two pull requests were opened to update chain information: one to update Alchemy chains after recent upgrades ([#1235](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1235)) and another to add Isthmus and Jovian timestamps for Settlus-Sepolia and Settlus-Mainnet ([#1234](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1234)).
- **CI/CD Improvements**: A pull request was initiated to drop the `circleci_ip_ranges` flag and migrate to the `circleci-repo-rpc-secrets` context for CI configurations ([#1233](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1233)).

## CLOSED ISSUES

- **Interop Hard Fork Implementation**: The issue concerning the implementation of the interop hard fork using the L2CM upgrade mechanism in `kona-node` and `op-node` was closed, as the work is being tracked under the Interop project. ([#20082](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20082))
- **RPC Namespace Migration**: The task to replace the supervisor RPC namespace with the interop filter namespace was marked as done. ([#20005](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20005))
- **Brotli Channel Divergence Fixes**: The issue detailing two distinct bugs causing divergence between Kona and op-node for brotli-compressed channels was closed, with all concerns addressed and follow-up work identified. ([#19333](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/19333))
- **Dispute Game Test Migration**: The issue to migrate remaining dispute game tests from `op-e2e/super_test.go` to `op-acceptance-tests` was closed, indicating completion. ([#20814](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20814))
- **`debug_executePayload` Investigation**: An investigation into whether `debug_executePayload` and related crates could be removed concluded that they are not removable as dead code, being an active, opt-in fast-path with a maintained server implementation in `op-reth`. ([#20879](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20879))

## NEW ISSUES

- **Flaky Test Identification**: Two new issues were opened to track flaky tests: `TestSupernodeInterop_SafeHeadProgression` ([#20851](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20851)) and `TestChallengerCountersPreGenesisGame` ([#20869](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20869)).

## ACTIVE ISSUES

- **Kona and op-node Brotli Divergence**: The discussion on [#19333](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/19333) concluded with the issue being closed as all concerns were fixed. The investigation revealed a Kona wrapper bug as the dominant cause of divergence, with a proposed 4-line fix eliminating 95% of divergences. The Rust `brotli` crate was identified as non-spec-compliant on corrupted inputs, and a fix for an upstream brotli crate bug was noted.
- **SDM Flashblocks Integration**: Issue [#20175](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20175) is currently blocked by another issue, `ethereum-optimism/optimism#20599`, indicating a dependency for its progress.
- **Interop Proofs Devnet**: On [#20489](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20489), the team is focused on testing networks and documenting results in a Notion document. This network is intended for long-term internal testing. The Definition of Done includes superdispute game played, withdrawals, proofs team approval, flashblocks working with interop, and conductor re-orgs working.
- **Devnet Spin-up**: For [#20691](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20691), the plan is to await `glamsterdam-devnet-4` images before attempting a full devnet in their infrastructure. Currently, efforts are focused on running a local devnet using `bal-devnet-6` images.
- **Flaky Test: `TestChallengerCountersPreGenesisGame`**: Issue [#20869](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20869) identified a root cause related to `plannedRollupStartBlockNumber` computation and the timing of `migrateSuperRootsWithProposal`. The flakiness is due to CI load variations. A fix is proposed to increase `preGenesisRollupStartBlockDelay` and add a post-migration L1-head re-read with a fast-fail invariant.
